\section[la vache]{la vache — a cow}

\label{lesson:FR-C85-vache}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the French for a desert, then the French for a wave.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: la vache}
\textbf{la vache} — \textquotedblleft{}a cow\textquotedblright{}. It gives \textbf{le lait}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for this chapter.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}

\end{itemize}

What does la vache mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A cow\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
